notes.title: Minor update (v1.02.03)
notes.notes:
Patch Update – Thank you for your support! 🎉 (January 23, 2025)

Made Tips clearer and more user-friendly.
Improved visual effects. Added missing sound effects to some jumpscares.
Players can no longer skip while in darkness.
Make sure to look for “something” lurking in the shadows. 👻
Checker is now recommended! Without it, there’s a lot more to remember.
Various minor bug fixes and UI improvements.

🌱The next installment in the No Ghost series is already in development!
Stay tuned! 🎶

notes.title: Minor update (v1.02.00)
notes.notes:
Thank you for your hard work!
Here’s the final update of the year:

Improved clarity in the UI.
Items newly added to the shop are now easier to identify.
Enhanced effects.
It’s now clear that the "Letter" is addressed to the player, acting as the one-day manager.
Fixed a bug where breaking a mirror in the dark state would prevent progress.

🌱 The next installment in the "No Ghosts" series has been decided!
The core elements of the series—short playthroughs, multiple endings, and collecting numerous outcomes—will remain intact, but the game system and atmosphere will change significantly.

However, I can’t guarantee it will be developed in 2025.
I aim to release at least one horror game per year, but it might not be part of this series.

Please look forward to it and prepare for new chills!

notes.title: Minor update (v1.00.33)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
I’ve been continuing to work on small updates, such as bug fixes and gameplay adjustments.

A Halloween update is also planned. However, there will be no additional endings this time.
Instead, I’m excited to announce that [b]a legendary Japanese manga artist[/b] will be contributing some bonus content. 👻

For more details, I’ll be posting updates on my X account, so please stay tuned and look forward to it!

notes.title: Update v1.00.30
notes.notes:
Thank you for your hard work!
And thank you to everyone who has played the game.

I’ve been updating the game based on your feedback and the streams I've watched.

Here’s what’s new in this update:
 -Adjusted the balance to make it easier to reach endings
 -Improved hint icon clarity
 -Tweaked the content and expressions in the Tips
 -Fixed any bugs that were found
 -The game is now easier to play, so if you haven't completed it yet, please continue to enjoy!
 -For those who have already played, it would mean a lot if you could leave a review. Your feedback is a strong  motivation for me, and it also has great significance on Steam. I truly appreciate it!

Well, keep on enjoying 🤗👻.
